hotspots.label: Name
hotspots.detail: With the SDK, the datasource name may contain only ASCII letters and digits.

hotspots.label: urlRegex
hotspots.detail: Avoid regexes that are too broad and capture other datasources' URLs, or too narrow.

hotspots.label: Identity references
hotspots.detail: isUserReferencedByEmail should be true if you want to refer to user identities by email.

hotspots.label: Category
hotspots.detail: The right category enables enhanced ranking. Set per-object categories with objectDefinitions.docCategory. Do not use PEOPLE; use /bulkindexemployees for employee data.

hotspots.label: Test datasource
hotspots.detail: All ranking signals are off, and beta users still need permission on each document.
